title: Porkchops To Bacon
description: This Resource Pack changes Porkchops into Bacon! Yummy.
body:
## Porkchops to Bacon
This Resource Pack converts the Porkchop Food Item into Bacon in Minecraft. This does not change the Item ID of the Porkchop, it only changes the Texture and Name of the default Minecraft Porkchop. You can obtain the Bacon item in the exact same way as you obtain the Porkchop.

### Upcoming Features
- Universal Version
- More Language Support
